issue_request: FHIR-3052 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core references-page issue asking to clarify misleading text that described cid: URIs in transactions as internal references, including whether cid: URIs could be used in documents or messages.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 3079, now git commit 20c997a5a51ec1a84a5faa13d9401f3f3eef43e8, which changed source/references.html from internal references to references within bundles and added that cid: URIs can be used in documents or messages too.
additional_context: A later references-page refactor in 2319e45e4115705f873661fe217ae2971eebc13f removed the cid-specific paragraph while reorganizing Reference.type and canonical-reference material. The current references page no longer makes the old misleading statement. Current Bundle source says fullUrl can be an arbitrary URI and Bundle entry references can use any URI scheme. Bundle and References are active build-scope source surfaces.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was needed because the seed page no longer contains the problem wording and the current Bundle material covers cid-like temporary URI schemes without duplicating cid-specific prose on the references page.
